\section{Experiments}
\label{sec:experiments}

\subsection{Experimental Setup}
\label{sec:setup}

We study lead-lag analysis pitfalls in iterative training collapse using Pythia-410M \cite{biderman2023pythia}, a 410M-parameter decoder-only language model.
Pythia provides a controlled setting: small enough for multi-seed experiments across five contamination levels, yet large enough to exhibit meaningful generation-over-generation degradation.
Cross-architecture validation uses GPT-2-medium (345M parameters, also decoder-only), a second transformer family of similar scale; results are reported in \S\ref{sec:method_sensitivity}, \S\ref{sec:regime}, and \S\ref{sec:discussion}.
Training data is drawn from WikiText-103 \cite{merity2017pointer}, using 5{,}000-sample subsets per generation.

Our protocol follows the replace paradigm of \citet{shumailov2024curse}, adapted for mixed synthetic-real training at $\alpha{<}1.0$.
Each generation $t$ proceeds in three steps: (1)~fine-tune the generation-$(t{-}1)$ model for 5{,}000 steps on a mixture of $\alpha$ fraction synthetic data and $(1{-}\alpha)$ fraction real data (AdamW optimizer, learning rate $5 \times 10^{-5}$, 500 warmup steps, weight decay $0.01$, batch size 4 for Pythia-410M, 32 for GPT-2-medium); (2)~generate 5{,}000 synthetic samples from the fine-tuned model (temperature $1.0$, top-$k{=}50$, max length 512 tokens); (3)~fully replace the synthetic pool.
We run $T{=}10$ generations (11 time points including the generation-0 baseline) across contamination levels $\alpha \in \{0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00\}$.
The $\alpha{=}1.0$ condition uses four random seeds $\{42, 43, 44, 45\}$; $\alpha{=}0.00$, $\alpha{=}0.25$, and $\alpha{=}0.75$ each use three seeds $\{42, 43, 44\}$; $\alpha{=}0.50$ uses three seeds $\{42, 43, 44\}$.

We track two \emph{canary metrics} (cheap-to-compute statistics hypothesized to precede downstream degradation, inspired by early-warning signals in dynamical systems \cite{scheffer2009early}) and three \emph{downstream metrics}.
Canary metrics are token entropy (next-token prediction entropy averaged over held-out samples) and expected calibration error (ECE).
Downstream metrics are distinct-1 and distinct-2 ($n$-gram diversity \cite{li2016diversity}, computed over all 5{,}000 generated samples per generation) and perplexity (evaluated on held-out real data).
Token entropy is the mean next-token prediction entropy $H(p_\theta | \text{context})$ averaged over 1{,}000 held-out samples; ECE uses 15 equal-width bins.

\section*{Limitations}
\label{sec:limitations}

Several limitations constrain the generalizability of our findings.

\paragraph{Model scale.}
Our experiments are validated at scales ${\leq}1.4$B parameters (GPT-2-medium 345M, Pythia-410M, OPT-1.3B), all decoder-only transformers small by contemporary standards.
Whether the temporal lead shortens or vanishes at frontier scale (7B+) is an open question requiring proportionally more compute per condition: 10 generations $\times$ 5{,}000 steps per generation makes iterative training at 7B+ prohibitively expensive for academic settings.
Encoder-decoder architectures (T5, BART) and non-autoregressive models (e.g., diffusion-based text generators) are entirely untested; their fundamentally different generation mechanisms may alter canary dynamics in ways that autoregressive decoder-only results cannot predict.
The batch size difference between architectures (4 for Pythia vs.\ 32 for GPT-2-medium) means each training step exposes $8\times$ more data in the latter, potentially accelerating collapse dynamics without altering the qualitative pattern.

\paragraph{Data domain and scale.}
Training data is drawn from a 5K-document subset of WikiText-103, three orders of magnitude smaller than typical pre-training corpora.
This scale gap means our iterative training dynamics reflect a low-data regime where overfitting to synthetic content may onset faster than in production-scale pipelines.
Domain-specific properties (vocabulary richness, syntactic complexity, topical diversity) may further influence canary-downstream coupling, and domains with inherently low diversity (e.g., legal text, code) could exhibit different canary dynamics.
The C4-domain generalization experiments (\S\ref{sec:generalization}) introduce an additional confound: switching from WikiText to C4 simultaneously changes both the textual domain and the data-scale characteristics, preventing full disentanglement of domain effects from scale effects within a single experimental comparison.

\paragraph{Pre-training data confound (C4).}
Our C4-domain generalization experiments (\S\ref{sec:generalization}) use Pythia models that were pre-trained on the Pile~\cite{gao2021pile}, which includes Common Crawl data overlapping with C4.
This means the model has prior exposure to the domain used for iterative training, potentially conflating domain familiarity with collapse dynamics.
The WikiText-103 experiments do not share this confound because Pythia's pre-training corpus does not include WikiText-103 directly.
Interpreting C4 results therefore requires caution: observed differences from the WikiText baseline may reflect domain familiarity effects rather than genuine domain-dependent collapse behavior.

\paragraph{Short time series ($T{=}10$).}
With 11 data points per series, our statistical analyses operate near the lower bound of what standard methods require.
This limits power for all methods and makes the Toda--Yamamoto procedure particularly unreliable (power estimated at 0.05--0.20 for our effect sizes).
We omit transfer entropy, a standard nonlinear Granger alternative, because kernel density estimation requires substantially longer time series (typically $T{\geq}100$) than our 10-generation design permits, yielding negligible statistical power at $T{=}10$.
Longer generation chains would improve statistical power but impose substantial computational cost.

\paragraph{Bivariate Granger $\neq$ causality.}
Bivariate Granger tests cannot exclude confounders.
An unobserved process (such as a latent shift in the training data distribution) could independently drive both token entropy and diversity metrics, producing spurious lead-lag associations.
Our multi-method consensus framework mitigates but does not eliminate this limitation; multivariate VAR models would be required to test for confounders directly.

\paragraph{Regime boundary uncertainty.}
The onset boundary at $\alpha{\approx}0.25$--$0.50$ is characterized with limited resolution (five $\alpha$ levels).
Whether this boundary is sharp (phase-transition-like) or gradual, and whether it shifts with model scale or data properties, remains open.
Three-seed replication at $\alpha{=}0.75$ confirms directional asymmetry (19/24 forward, 0/24 reverse) but method consensus remains transitional (Tier~2--3), leaving the exact boundary position uncertain.

\paragraph{No intervention experiment.}
We observe that token entropy Granger-precedes diversity collapse but do not test whether acting on canary signals (e.g., halting training or reducing $\alpha$) can prevent or delay collapse onset.
Without intervention evidence, the practical value of the canary remains theoretical.

\paragraph{Replace-only protocol.}
Our experiments use replace-only data accumulation; accumulate-mode training~\cite{dey2024breaking,kazdan2025collapse} may exhibit qualitatively different canary dynamics or eliminate the need for canary monitoring entirely~\cite{falahati2026curated}.

\paragraph{Scope limited to diversity metrics.}
Our canary claims are scoped to distinct-$n$ diversity metrics~\cite{li2016diversity}, not to model collapse broadly~\cite{schaeffer2025position}, as the perplexity channel proved spurious after differencing.
This scoping is theoretically motivated by the calibration-diversity tradeoff~\cite{cao2025entropycal}, but means our findings may not generalize to other collapse manifestations (e.g., factual degradation, reasoning capability loss).

lines: \paragraph{Practical utility paradox.}
The canary framework exhibits a paradox: it works best where it is least needed.
At $\alpha{\geq}0.75$, token entropy reliably Granger-precedes diversity collapse, but at these contamination levels degradation is already severe and likely detectable through simpler means.

-At $\alpha{\leq}0.25$, where early warning would be most valuable, the canary signal is undetectable by any method tested; at $\alpha{=}0.50$, detectability is seed-dependent (0/8--6/8, 3~seeds, median 3/8), marking the onset boundary where ECE outperforms token entropy as the more sensitive canary.
+At $\alpha{\leq}0.25$, where early warning would be most valuable, the canary signal is undetectable by any method tested.

+A single-seed observation at $\alpha{=}0.10$ sharpens this limitation: distinct-1 already declines by 39.6\% (comparable to the multi-seed $\alpha{=}0.25$ result of $-40.3\%$), yet token entropy differs from the null by less than 1 percentage point ($-5.3\%$ vs.\ $-4.6{\pm}0.4\%$).
+This canary blind spot means that even small amounts of synthetic contamination can trigger diversity collapse without activating any canary warning.
+At $\alpha{=}0.50$, detectability is seed-dependent (0/8--6/8, 3~seeds, median 3/8), marking the onset boundary where ECE outperforms token entropy as the more sensitive canary.

This sensitivity difference reflects how each metric aggregates distributional information: ECE decomposes calibration error across multiple probability bins, making it responsive to changes in the shape of the predicted distribution rather than just its mean, while token entropy compresses the full distribution into a single scalar average.
At moderate contamination ($\alpha{=}0.50$), the distributional shifts are subtle enough that bin-level decomposition detects them but the global average does not.

This is not a framework deficiency but an inherent characteristic of collapse dynamics: at low contamination, diversity changes are too small relative to inter-generation noise for any temporal lead to emerge above the statistical detection floor~\cite{boettiger2012limits}.

# Paper Framing — distrib_canary_collapse

## Target Venue
- Primary: **EMNLP 2026 Main Track** (D043, 用户指定)
- ARR cycle: June 2026 (deadline ~June 15, 待确认具体日期)
- 格式: ACL 系列模板 (acl.sty), 8 页正文 + unlimited appendix
- Note: ARR May cycle 已过；June cycle 对齐 EMNLP 2026 commitment deadline

## Narrative Structure (D027: Option B reframe)

**主线**：方法论陷阱 + 多方法共识框架（MMCT）。Canary prediction 为系统性 case study。
**三根支柱**：(1) MMCT 框架 = Claim 3 方法论贡献；(2) Regime map + 盲区 = Claim 2 分析贡献；(3) Downstream 指标选择 = D085 实践指导。
**Claim 呈现顺序**：论文中 Claim 3 领衔 → Claim 2 (regime map + blind zone) → Claim 1 (case study) → Claim 4 (practical intervention)。
**内部编号保持不变**（避免引用混乱），论文呈现时重排。

## Core Claims (4 条，内部编号不变)

1. **Canary→Diversity Granger-Causal Precedence (论文中作为 Case Study Finding)**: token_entropy 对 diversity 退化（distinct_1/2）具有 Granger-causal precedence——领先 1-2 代，差分后仍显著，证据来自多方法一致性：cross-correlation（lag=-1, std=0.0, |r|>0.99, p<0.004, 4/4 seed）、差分交叉相关（显著）、threshold onset（canary gen 1-2, diversity gen 3-4）、**permutation Granger（差分后仍 4/4 seed 显著，F=612-2615）**。论文可用措辞 (D037 更新)：*"We demonstrate Granger-causal precedence of canary metrics at α≥0.75: α=1.0 achieves 24/24 FDR-sig (4 seeds), α=0.75 achieves 3/4 FDR-sig with the fourth borderline (p_fdr=0.054; single seed, pending multi-seed confirmation C001). Consistent temporal precedence (cross-correlation lag=+1, r=0.80–0.94) is observed across all contamination levels, though formal Granger tests at α≤0.50 do not reach FDR-corrected significance at T=11 (power analysis: §X)."*升级上限：Granger ≠ true causality（Granger 1969），Discussion 一句话声明；双变量模型无法排除未观测混淆因子（详见 Reviewer Concerns 表）。ECE 前向 consensus 与 token_entropy 等效但存在 bidirectional coupling（详见约束 #9）。注意：TY Granger 在 N=11 下不可用于区分真/伪关联（见 Claim 3），核心证据链基于多方法一致性而非单一 TY 背书。**D063 泛化证据**：Table 7 跨 7 conditions（3 architectures × 2 scales × 2 domains）K≥4=5/8-6/8。**Diversity-only subset（排除→ppl pairs）consensus 41/42 = 97.6%**，仅 1.4B s42 的 1 个 diversity pair 未达 K≥4。→ppl pairs 0/14 达 K≥4（结构性失败，非方法缺陷），canary→perplexity 的系统性弱信号作为 explicit finding 报告——diversity collapse 是可预测的下游维度，perplexity 不是。
2. **Regime-Dependent Predictability**: 可预测性取决于 collapse 维度和 contamination regime——canary→diversity 在差分后仍 robust（6/6 pair × 4/4 seed），但 canary→perplexity **经差分检验确认为伪回归**（0/4 seed, F≈0, p=0.99），未差分时的"信号"（F=16-36）完全由共享非平稳趋势驱动（D017）。ECE→perplexity 的反向因果同理存疑。**Claim 2 reframing (D022)**: 从"不同 α 下 lead time 不同"升级为"不同 α 下 **detectability** 不同"——α=0.25 差分 Granger 0/8 FDR sig vs α=1.0 的 24/24，同一 pair 的统计可检测性随 contamination level 剧变。**D037 更新 + D075/D085**：8-point regime map（0.00/0.05/0.10/0.25/0.50/0.60/0.75/1.00），detectability 在 α=0.50→0.75 间出现阶跃（0%→83% BH FDR-sig）。**D075 盲区**：α=0.10 下 canary 与 null 不可区分（PermG 0/8, K≥4 0/8, 跨 seed+跨精度稳健 D084），但 diversity drift 已达 -39.6%——canary 检测存在下界。**D085**：α=1.00 permG 检出率（75%）低于 α=0.75（83%），根因是 perplexity 在极端 collapse 下丧失 lag structure（8/8 non-sig 全在 canary→ppl 对），distinct_N 对 100% 显著——downstream 指标选择影响 detectability。**Evidence strategy (Reviewer 共识)**：Primary = raw drift magnitude dose-response（distinct_1: -14%@α=0 → -40%@α=0.25 → ~-93%@α=1.0），方法无关、不可争议；Secondary = 差分 Granger FDR sig rate vs α，展示 detectability boundary at α~0.75。**不用 naive_xcorr 做 primary**——与 Claim 3 自相矛盾。Predictability regime map 划定可预测/不可预测边界（"phase diagram" 需 ≥6 个 α 值 + uncertainty interval 才成立，当前 5 个 α 值下用 "regime map"）。
3. **Method Selection Sensitivity and Regime-Dependent Validity**（升级自 Methodological Rigor；D022 升级候选：method × regime interaction）: 在典型 generation 数（N≈10）下，lead-lag 结论对分析方法和超参数高度敏感，且**同一方法在不同 α regime 下结论翻转**（diff Granger: α=1.0 24/24 FDR sig → α=0.25 0/8）。升级措辞候选："Method sensitivity is compounded by regime dependence: the same statistical test applied to the same metric pair can yield significant or null results depending on contamination level"。**三层证据结构**：**(Layer 1)** naive Pearson 找到 16/16 显著——方法宽松时一切 "显著"；**(Layer 2)** 一阶差分翻转整条 perplexity 通道（8/8→0/8 SIG）而 diversity 通道不变（12/12→12/12）——一个方法论选择决定通道存亡（D017）；**(Layer 3)** TY d_max sensitivity 使结论在 ~0%↔94% spurious rate 间震荡——超参数选择同样致命。方法论贡献不是"提供正确的检验"，而是**暴露方法选择敏感性并提出多方法一致性框架**——只有跨方法（cross-corr + 差分 + threshold + permutation Granger）和跨 seed 都一致的关联才可信。这是迭代训练文献中被忽视的方法论陷阱。

4. **Canary-Based Early Intervention (Practical Demonstration)**: 基于 canary 的 predictive 干预（token_entropy drop >15% → 切换 clean data）比基于 downstream metric 的 reactive 干预（distinct_1 drop >10%）早 1 代触发、峰值 perplexity 降 63%、恢复快 2 代。在 α=1.0 下 s42 fp32 + s43 bf16 一致确认。**Scope**: 当前仅在极端污染（α=1.0）下验证，α=0.75 transitional regime 实验（interv_pred_v4）进行中。如 α=0.75 干预效果弱，claim 需限定为 "high-contamination regime only"。**定位**: 论文中作为 practical value demonstration，不与 Claim 1-3 并列为核心贡献，但提供 "so what" 的回答——canary prediction 不仅是统计现象，有实际干预价值。

## Story Spine (D027: Option B reframe)

- **Problem**: Model collapse 文献中的 lead-lag 分析（"哪些指标预测崩溃"）日益增多（Du et al., SIGMA, DCES），但**方法选择对结论的影响未被系统性审视**。Du et al. 非正式观察到 ECE 领先 accuracy，仅限单指标对、1-3 代、无统计检验。现有工作的方法论基础薄弱：无差分检验（不排除伪回归）、无多方法交叉验证、无多重比较校正、无 regime-dependent 分析。

- **Gap**: 没有工作系统性回答：(1) lead-lag 结论在多大程度上取决于分析方法的选择？(2) 同一统计检验在不同 contamination regime 下结论是否稳定？(3) 如何建立可靠的 lead-lag 判定框架？**Scheffer et al. (2009, 2012)** 在生态/气候科学中建立了临界转变早期预警框架，但尚未被 model collapse 文献引入，其方法论严谨性（多方法交叉验证 + regime-dependent analysis）恰好是本领域所缺失的。

- **Our approach**: 以 canary prediction for model collapse 为系统性 case study，暴露 lead-lag 分析中的三个方法论陷阱：(1) 方法选择敏感性——同一数据集上 5 种统计方法从 100% 显著到 0% 显著（Claim 3）；(2) 未差分的伪回归——canary→perplexity 通道在差分后完全消失（Claim 1 case study）；(3) regime-dependent validity——同一检验在不同 α 下结论翻转（Claim 2）。在此基础上提出**多方法一致性共识框架**（multi-method consensus framework）作为解决方案：只有跨方法（cross-corr + 差分 + threshold + permutation Granger）和跨 seed 都一致的关联才可信。

- **Headline result (D037 更新)**: "In iterative synthetic training with Pythia-410M, naive correlation identifies 100% of canary-collapse metric pairs as significant, while differenced permutation Granger retains only 25% — and this method-dependent gap is compounded by regime dependence: the same test applied to the same metric pair yields 24/24 FDR-significant results at α=1.0, 3/4 at α=0.75, but 0/8 at α≤0.50. We propose a multi-method consensus framework and, applying it, identify token entropy as a robust 1-generation-ahead canary for diversity collapse at α≥0.75."

- **Title direction**: "Method Matters: Pitfalls and a Multi-Method Consensus Framework for Lead-Lag Analysis in Iterative Training Collapse"

- **文献定位 (保留)**：SIGMA 提供谱监控但无 lead-time 量化；DCES 反应式而非预测式；Du et al. 是最接近的经验前辈但方法论不足；Kalinowski 拓扑 CI 针对表征坍缩非合成数据退化且计算昂贵。Truong & Truong 证明一阶相变下标准早期预警指标失效。理论分析方面：Seddik et al. (2024), Gerstgrasser et al. (2024), Dey et al. ## Key Narrative Constraints (from MVP + plan_003)

1. **不能 claim "canary predicts model collapse"** — 只能 claim "canary predicts diversity collapse"。token_entropy→perplexity 经差分检验确认为伪回归（0/4 seed, F≈0, p=0.99, D017），未差分时的"弱信号"完全由共享非平稳趋势驱动。论文措辞用"spurious association confirmed by first-differencing"，不再用"弱信号"
2. **ECE→perplexity 和 token_entropy→perplexity 均为伪信号 (D017)** — 差分后两者均 0/4 seed 显著。未差分时观察到的"方向相反"（token_entropy 领先 vs perplexity 领先 ECE）是共享趋势的不同表现形式。论文报告差分前后对比作为方法论教训，不再需要机制性解释

27. **Consensus score 跨 α 比较须标注标准差异 (D038)** — α=0.75 consensus 11/16 robust 使用单种子 method-agreement 标准（≥4/5 方法判定显著），α=1.0 consensus 6/16 robust 使用 4-seed full consensus 标准（≥3/4 seeds × ≥4/5 方法）。两个数字不可直接对比——11/16 > 6/16 不意味着 α=0.75 信号更强，而是标准更宽松。论文中引用时**必须标注标准差异**，禁止直接对比暗示 α=1.0 信号更弱
28. **token_entropy→perplexity 在 α=0.75 单种子 consensus 中的 ROBUST 标记不可引用 (D038)** — α=0.75 单种子 consensus 将 token_entropy→perplexity 标为 ROBUST（因多方法一致通过），但 D017 已用 4-seed 差分检验确认该方向为 spurious（自相关驱动，差分后 0/4 sig）。这是单种子 consensus 的已知局限——无法检测共享非平稳趋势导致的伪关联。论文中**不得引用该方向作为 α=0.75 的 robust evidence**，仅限 canary→diversity 方向
29. **D075 Canary 盲区 (α=0.10)** — 10% 合成数据污染下，canary（entropy/ECE）与 0% null 不可区分（drift <1%），但 diversity 退化已达 -39.6%。PermG 0/8, TY 0/8, K≥4 0/8。跨 seed (s42 fp32 + s43 bf16) 跨精度一致（D084）。**论文定位**：(a) canary 检测存在下界，honest limitation；(b) diversity 对微量污染的脆弱性是独立发现——5-10% 污染 diversity 已全损但 canary 无信号；(c) 丰富 Claim 2 regime map，低端边界从 α=0.25 延伸到 α=0.10
30. **D079 bf16 系统性混淆** — bf16 stochastic rounding 系统性抑制 collapse（entropy 5.2×差异, ppl ~730×差异）。**硬约束**：Table 7 + dose-response 主轴只用 fp32；所有新小模型(≤3B) fp32 强制；6.9B 因内存限制保持 bf16，framing 为"bf16 条件下 pattern 是否持续"。bf16 数据降级为 supplementary evidence。**论文机会**：bf16 作为隐式正则化的发现本身有价值，可在 Discussion 作为 "precision matters" 段落，但不纳入核心 claim
31. **D085 Perplexity 在极端 collapse 下丧失 lag structure** — α=1.00 permG 检出率 75% (24/32) 低于 α=0.75 的 83% (20/24)。8/32 non-sig 全集中在 canary→perplexity 对，4 seeds 一致（p 0.35-0.99）。根因非 BH 校正伪影（0 次 BH 翻转），是 perplexity 时序在极端 collapse 下变为近单调爆炸增长，破坏 permG 的 lag structure。distinct_N 对跨全部 seed 100%。**论文贡献**：(a) 支持推荐 diversity 类指标而非 perplexity 作为 downstream；(b) 丰富 Claim 3（downstream 指标选择也是方法论敏感性的一个维度）
32. **MMCT 正式命名** — 多方法一致性共识框架正式命名为 **Multi-Method Consensus Test (MMCT)**。null-calibrated（FPR=0 at α=0.00），加权方案（FPR-inverse weighting），检出率 43.8%/58.3%/79.2% at α=0.25/0.50/0.75。在论文 Method 节正式定义，Results 节展示其优于单方法的 sensitivity-specificity tradeoff
33. **Confident diffusion 机制 (scale_14b, Discussion 材料)** — Pythia-1.4B α=0.50 effective_rank +62%（gen_0→1 阶跃后 plateau），与 410M 的倒 U 型 (+27%) 对比为 scale-amplified phenomenon。机制假说：collapse 使模型输出分布从结构化/有峰转为扁平/扩散到更多 embedding 维度。仅限 Discussion 段落，不纳入 Core Claims（泛化性待跨架构验证）
34. **Constraint #12 升级：8 个 α 值已满足 "regime map" 门槛** — 当前有 8 个非平凡 α 值（0.00/0.05/0.10/0.25/0.50/0.60/0.75/1.00），超过约束 #12 的 ≥6 阈值。论文中可使用 "predictability regime map"。如果 α=0.05 和 α=0.60 fp32 数据提供 uncertainty interval（跨 seed），可考虑升级为 "phase diagram"——但需谨慎，建议维持 "regime map"

      - "Approach: 3 pitfalls + multi-method consensus framework with FPR/FNR calibration"
      - "Results: naive correlation 100% sig → differenced Granger 25%; consensus framework achieves FPR=0/FNR=0 on reference extremes"
      - "Case study: token entropy Granger-causes diversity collapse at α≥0.75 with 1-gen lead"

  - section: introduction
    word_budget: 1100

    key_points:
      - "Model collapse 文献日益关注 lead-lag 分析（Du et al., SIGMA, DCES），但方法论基础薄弱"
      - "Gap: 无差分检验、无多方法交叉验证、无 FDR 校正、无 regime-dependent 分析"
      - "Our approach: systematic case study exposing 3 pitfalls + consensus framework"
      - "Headline: naive 100% sig → differenced 25%; same test flips across α regimes"

          - "d_max sensitivity: 0%↔94% spurious rate swing"
          - "Cohen κ=0.185 (poor inter-method agreement)"
          - "method × α interaction: naive 100% everywhere vs permG dose-response"
          - "Ref to Fig 2"
      - name: "Regime-Dependent Detectability (Claim 2)"
        word_budget: 400
        key_points:
          - "5-point regime map: Granger FDR sig rate vs α"
          - "Detectability boundary at α≈0.50-0.75"
          - "Raw drift magnitude dose-response (primary): distinct_1 -14%→-40%→-93%"
          - "Non-monotonic diversity decline at α=0.25 (single-seed caveat)"
          - "α=0.50 null = positive finding (synchronous collapse, no temporal lead)"

      - name: "Case Study: Canary Prediction (Claim 1)"

    word_budget: 700

    key_points:

      - "FPR/FNR dimension asymmetry (D041): FPR method-only, FNR method×seed joint"
      - "Phase 3 three-phase dynamics (if multi-seed confirmed): observation window sensitivity as Claim 3 evidence"
      - "Limitations: single architecture family, T=10 short series, no intervention experiment"
      - "Future work: multi-variate VAR, cross-architecture validation, online monitoring integration"

    dependencies: [discussion]

1	\section{Related Work}
2	\label{sec:related_work}
3	
4	\paragraph{Model collapse in iterative training.}
5	
6	The phenomenon of iterative training collapse was formalized by \citet{shumailov2024curse}, who showed that recursively replacing real data with model-generated text causes progressive tail erosion across VAEs, GMMs, and language models, and by \citet{alemohammad2024mad}, who demonstrated quality--diversity tradeoffs in self-consuming generative loops for image models.
7	Theoretical analyses have since sharpened these results: \citet{dohmatob2024tale} recast collapse as a change in scaling-law exponents, showing that even small fractions of synthetic data alter effective scaling behavior, while \citet{dohmatob2025strong} proved that collapse can occur even when synthetic data constitutes a vanishingly small fraction of the training set.
8	\citet{hataya2023will} provided early empirical evidence that large-scale generative models degrade future datasets through web-scale contamination, showing that even state-of-the-art models produce training-data artifacts detectable in downstream models, a finding that motivates our focus on contamination-level-dependent analysis.
9	\citet{seddik2024bad} formalized the statistical analysis of training on synthetic data, deriving excess risk bounds that quantify how synthetic fraction and model misspecification jointly govern degradation; their framework predicts regime-dependent behavior consistent with the onset boundary we observe empirically at $\alpha{\approx}0.25$--$0.50$.
10	The role of data accumulation has been a central theme.
